title: observability: add token-KV metrics & tracing panels; refine alerts
author: Maya Thompson
description: Motivation: Improve visibility into KV-cache behavior at token granularity and correlate KV misses with token-level latency/cost. This PR adds new metrics collectors, tracing spans for KV lookups, dashboard panels that surface token-level cost/latency breakdowns, and tuned alerting rules to reduce noise. Changes include instrumentation in the runtime, a lightweight sampling strategy for traces, dashboard JSON, alert rules, and docs updates. Checklist: [x] Add kv metrics collector and exporter; [x] Instrument tracing spans for KV lookups; [x] New dashboard panels (token-level cost/latency, KV hit/miss rates, per-model breakdowns); [x] Tiered alert thresholds to reduce noise; [x] Docs and runbook updates; [x] CI + e2e smoke tests. Impact: Observability UX improvement only; no breaking API changes. See related Linear items ENG-1423 (dashboard work) and ENG-1500 (alert tuning).
commits: a1b2c3d: add kv_metrics_collector with prometheus export and initial unit tests
d4e5f6g: instrument runtime KV lookup path with tracing spans and attach token metadata (sampling)
h7i8j9k: add dashboard JSON, alert rules, docs, and tweak thresholds for tiered alerting
review_comments: Avery Chen (reviewer): Left a comment on thresholding - current 5% miss rate alert is too noisy for small customers; suggest 10% for free/tier and 5% for enterprise.
Maya Thompson (author): Updated alert rules to be tier-aware (10% for basic, 5% for enterprise) and added explanatory labels and runbook links.
Samir Patel (SRE): Asked for retention/aggregation window changes to avoid daily spike noise; switched aggregation to 15m/1h buckets and added smoothing for 24h trends.

Lucia Gomez (observability): Noted that attaching token text to traces would spike cardinality; implemented 1% deterministic sampling for success paths and full sampling for error paths; added redaction and a max-token-length cap.
Avery Chen (approver): Approved after CI green and manual dashboard smoke test passed.
ci_checks: perf regression: within acceptable bounds (no >5% regression on token latency synthetic workload)
release_notes: Added token-level KV cache metrics and tracing spans. New dashboard panels for token-KV cost/latency breakdowns and per-model KV behavior. Tiered alert thresholds to reduce noise; sampling strategy to control trace cardinality. Docs and runbook added.
